description: Specifications/files: DS HistoryBrowser composes existing History filters/table/row/bulkbar; optional SimplePagination; DS ConversationDetail reuses BO transcript, ChatMessage info/trace/feedback/shares. Parameterize routes/actions/identity and safe artifact URLs. BO call sites consume shared components with original semantics; no auth/event delegation. Tests first: components BO default appearance/selectors and People no identity/destructive controls, paging and route overrides, details full info/attachments. Storybook update existing history stories and add cohesive component stories. Mocking: none. Docs: DESIGN and bo-components. User explicitly approves extraction and reuse wiring.

comments.text: Complete: BO and People consume stateless shared HistoryBrowser and ConversationDetail. Existing filters/table/rows/bulk bar, bubbles, feedback/info/trace and share presentation reused; channel/status choices, destinations, selection/actions, identity and optional paging parameterized. Existing BO bleed and legacy presentation retained. PersonHeader icons/logo/theme/account markup preserved; only authorized Settings link added. Shared default timezone lookup now uses existing Engine action, with failing-then-passing routing/cache regression; Timezone 100%. Shared new components 100% coverage. Live Storybook smoke passed both new stories; iframe containers prevent repeated demo IDs without changing application selectors.

title: [zaq-5vz] Extract and wire shared BO HistoryBrowser and ConversationDetail presentation
